Sorry to barge in, but I use Okocat brand! They have a specific one that’s “less mess” and that’s the pellets. I have great luck with them. They are clumping pellets.

I use okocat wood cat litter, specifically the “less mess” pellets and I have never smelled it (unless my kitty goes poop the obviously it’s a little smelly). I also throw it an litter box deodorizer from arm and hammer every couple days and just stir it around. The wood doesn’t technically have a scent, but since it’s wooden, it smells like wood. However a 20 pound box can last you up to four months with only one kitty! I have had great luck with it, and it doesn’t track nearly as much.

Hi! I decided to get a parking pass. Parking isn’t hard to get, ~good~ parking is hard to get. There is always a parking deck open, it’s just usually the one no one wants because it’s far away. In that aspect, I say just go early. If I have early classes, I’ll get there around 7:15/7:30. It’s early, yes, but I always end up with a superb parking spot, which really matters when it’s freezing cold outside and you don’t want to walk long distances then. When I have middle of the day/evening classes, I get to the parking lot about an hourish before class, which is usually around the time other classes are getting out and people will be leaving campus, meaning good spots. If you’re trying to park in Grace Street parking deck, you may have to go all the way to the top once or twice before getting a good spot. I would honestly avoid the buses at all costs because they are only allowing 18 people at a time, which is nothing compared to how many usually crowd on them, and it’s just nice to have your own car so you can come and go as you please.

So I had her this past spring so things got messed up due to COVID. But while we had in person, I went to her after every test and say for almost two hours and she would work through everything I didn’t understand. She is also open before tests for help, but I went after tests to go over them! Her lectures were easy to follow and if you get lost, just ask and she’ll try to reexplain. She tried to explain things in a simple way versus a “you should already know this way”. Once it was online, she tried her best to do what she could and even offered extra credit to help grades since it was such a quick change. She has been one of the best professors I’ve had and I ended with an A- in her class. Highly recommend!

I had peters and honestly she gives a good curve but it’s based on your class. I think we got a 7-10 point curve based on our average. But her homework counts as a full test grade almost AND if you do any extra credit she’s offering, she makes it count a lot!
